entities.summary: In stellar evolution, an FU Orionis star is a pre–main-sequence star which displays an extreme change in magnitude and spectral type. One example is the star V1057 Cyg, which became six magnitudes brighter and went from spectral type dKe to F-type supergiant during 1969–1970. These stars are named after their type-star, FU Orionis.
